title: Dynamic Reasoning in Next-Gen Detection and Response: An Empirical Study of LLM Triage, Reinforcement Tuning, and Adversarial Evasion
abstract: arXiv:2611.33470v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present an end-to-end empirical study of dynamic reasoning in next-generation detection and response pipelines, evaluating how static classifiers, graph-based signal fusion, and large language model (LLM) triage agents perform under strict human-analyst attention budgets (Recall at B alerts/day). Across 56 reproducible experiments spanning a multi-layer enterprise-and-cloud simulator and four public datasets (SOREL-20M, BODMAS, LANL, and DARPA Transparent Computing), we test twelve architectural claims governing modern fleet-scale defense. translated_title: 下一代检测与响应中的动态推理：LLM分诊、强化调优与对抗规避的实证研究
translated_abstract: 我们对下一代检测与响应流水线中的动态推理进行了一项端到端的实证研究，评估了静态分类器、基于图的信号融合以及大型语言模型（LLM）分诊代理在严格的分析师注意力预算（每日B条警报下的召回率）约束下的表现。通过覆盖多层企业-云模拟器和四个公开数据集（SOREL-20M、BODMAS、LANL和DARPA Transparent Computing）的56个可复现实验，我们检验了制约现代大规模防御体系的十二项架构主张。首先，我们表明：即使在计算成本几乎可以忽略的情况下（每百万事件不到0.0003美元），固定分析师预算下被监控机群规模的扩大会使召回率减半；并且稀有度加权的图风险传播方法无需神经训练即可超越GraphSAGE。其次，对前沿推理模型以及微调后的开源权重模型（Qwen3-4B）进行警报分诊评估后发现，无约束的LLM自动关闭机制会消除……
tldr: 本文通过56个实验实证评估了LLM分诊、图信号融合与强化调优在下一代安全检测与响应流水线中的表现，发现在固定分析师预算下机群规模扩大会使召回率减半，而无约束的LLM自动关闭警报机制存在隐患。
en_tdlr: An end-to-end empirical study of next-gen detection and response pipelines showing that fleet growth halves recall under fixed analyst budgets, rarity-weighted graph risk propagation outperforms GraphSAGE without neural training, and unconstrained LLM auto-closure poses significant triage risks.
